verify_subject: Confirm your email address for Tildeck
verify_body:
Welcome to Tildeck.

Confirm that this is your email address by opening this link within 24 hours:
{link}

If you did not create a Tildeck account on {server}, you can ignore this message.
approve_subject: A new device wants to open your Tildeck vault
approve_body:
The device "{device}" signed in to your Tildeck account on {server} and is waiting for approval.

If this was you, approve it within one hour:
{link}

If it was not you, do not approve it and change your master password: someone knows it.
device_added_subject: A device was added to your Tildeck account
device_added_body:
The device "{device}" can now open your Tildeck vault on {server}.

If you did not add it, revoke it from one of your devices and change your master password.
device_revoked_subject: A device was removed from your Tildeck account
device_revoked_body: The device "{device}" was removed from your Tildeck account on {server} and can no longer sync.
password_changed_subject: Your Tildeck master password was changed
password_changed_body:
The master password of your Tildeck account on {server} was changed.

If you did not change it, use your recovery key to take the account back.
recovery_used_subject: Your Tildeck recovery key was used
recovery_used_body:
Your recovery key was used to set a new master password for your Tildeck account on {server}. Every other device was signed out.

If you did not do this, someone has your recovery key.
approve_page_body: The device "{device}" asked to open your Tildeck vault. Approve it only if you signed in on it yourself.
approved_body: The device can now open your vault. You can close this page.
link_invalid_body: It was already used, it expired, or it is incomplete. Ask Tildeck for a new one.
